number of parameters: 0
fields:

constructor:

def TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.IsWellFormed : Int → Int → SliceShape.Axis → Prop :=
fun extent declared axis =>
  0 ≤ axis.start ∧
    axis.start ≤ axis.limit ∧ axis.limit ≤ extent ∧ 0 < axis.stride ∧ 0 ≤ declared ∧ axis.elementCount = declared
def TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.removeRedundantStride : SliceShape.Axis → SliceShape.Axis :=
fun axis =>
  if axis.stride ≠ 1 ∧ (axis.stride ≥ axis.limit ∨ axis.start + axis.stride ≥ axis.limit) then
    { start := axis.start, limit := axis.start + 1, stride := 1 }
  else axis
def TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.reorderReverse : Int → SliceShape.Axis → SliceShape.Axis :=
fun extent axis =>
  have stepCount := (axis.limit - axis.start - 1).tdiv axis.stride;
  have adjustedLimit := axis.start + stepCount * axis.stride + 1;
  { start := extent - axis.start - (adjustedLimit - axis.start), limit := extent - axis.start, stride := axis.stride }
theorem TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds : ∀ {extent declared : Int} {axis : SliceShape.Axis},
  SliceShape.IsWellFormed extent declared axis →
    ∀ (index : Int),
      0 ≤ index → index < declared → 0 ≤ axis.start + axis.stride * index ∧ axis.start + axis.stride * index < extent :=
fun {extent declared} {axis} valid index nonnegative bounded =>
  And.casesOn valid fun start_nonnegative right =>
    And.casesOn right fun ordered right =>
      And.casesOn right fun limit_bounded right =>
        And.casesOn right fun positive right =>
          And.casesOn right fun left count =>
            have numerator_nonnegative :=
              Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds._proof_1_1✝ index ordered positive a;
            have product_bound :=
              Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a => axis.stride * _a ≤ axis.limit - axis.start + axis.stride - 1) (Eq.symm count)))
                (Int.mul_tdiv_self_le numerator_nonnegative);
            have step_bound :=
              Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                  TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds._proof_1_2✝ index bounded count a)
                (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                  TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds._proof_1_3✝ index positive a);
            have product_nonnegative :=
              Int.mul_nonneg
                (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                  TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds._proof_1_3✝ index positive a)
                nonnegative;
            ⟨Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds._proof_1_4✝ index start_nonnegative product_nonnegative
                  a,
              Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
                TensorRewrite.Pilot.SliceShape.coordinate_bounds._proof_1_5✝ index limit_bounded product_bound
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg (fun _a => axis.stride * index + _a ≤ axis.stride * declared) (Int.mul_one axis.stride))
                    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ axis.stride * declared) (Int.mul_add axis.stride index 1))
                      step_bound))
                  a⟩
